programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    background = max({value for row in grid for value in row}, key=lambda value: sum(row.count(value) for row in grid))
    bars = []
    for row in grid:
        i = 0
        while i < len(row):
            if row[i] == background:
                i += 1
                continue
            color = row[i]
            while i < len(row) and row[i] == color:
                i += 1
            bars.append(color)
    cells = sorted(bars, reverse=True)[:6]
    cells += [0] * (6 - len(cells))
    return [cells[:3], cells[3:]]
'''
